_doc: The declared CPU's cpuid, as DATA: the raw leaves of the pinned reference host (identity: verify/cpuref.json) and the declared-machine masks applied to them. lift/tools/gen_cpuref.py generates lift/rt/fnvl_cpuref.h, lift/rt/rcpref.h and lift/rt/cpumodel_tab.inc from cpuref.json + this file; nothing restates these values by hand. Provenance of `raw`: transcribed from the table recorded in lift/rt/cpumodel.c at 286fdc93 (a `cpuid` run on the pinned host); tools/cpuid_dump.c regenerates it on that host (not run on this machine: it is family 6 model 173, not the reference model 207). Fields the platform owns (leaf 1 EBX [23:16], leaf 4 EAX [31:26] and the L3 share field [25:14]) are zero in `raw` and filled by rt/cpumodel.c from FNVNX_NPROC.
masks_doc: leaf1 EDX = raw & ~clear: SS (27) cleared (kept HTT 28, FXSR SSE SSE2 ...); leaf1 ECX = raw & keep (everything cleared: the lifter implements MMX/SSE/SSE2 only); 0x80000001 EDX = raw & keep (NX only); ECX = raw & keep (LAHF64, LZCNT/ABM, PREFETCHW cleared). max leaves: a 2010-era game asks leaves 0 1 2 4 and 0x80000000..4.
